title: Selangor govt announces plans for flood mitigation | The Star
text:
Selangor govt announces plans for flood mitigation | The Star
SELANGOR has declared 37 flood-prone areas in the state as being serious and will draw up an action plan to counter this.
State Infrastructure and Public Facilities Committee chairman Zaidy Abdul Talib said 83 serious floods from the 171 hotspots were reported last year.
